interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian right-of-way and slow entering vehicles.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement 'no parking' zones near the driveway to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install signs to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians crossing the driveway entrance.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous, ADA-compliant concrete sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation from vehicles.

interventions.title: Marked Pedestrian Walkways
interventions.description: Install painted or textured walkways through the parking lot to provide a designated path for pedestrians from the perimeter to the store entrances.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Incorporate raised landscaped islands within the parking lot to break up the asphalt expanse and provide safe waiting areas.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps or tables in the main circulation aisles to slow vehicle speeds within the parking area.
